topic: How to Remove Soap Scum From a Shower
notes: Keep advice material-specific. Use mild, non-abrasive cleaning as the default for common tub/shower finishes, and tell readers to test unfamiliar cleaners in an inconspicuous area. Do not recommend universal acid or bleach recipes because shower surrounds, metal trim, natural stone and coated surfaces vary. Follow the surface manufacturer and cleaner label.
